title: Show authenticated Internet Identity principal in app header

requirements.summary: Show the logged-in Internet Identity principal (short form) in the header across all authenticated screens without impacting responsive layout.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user is not authenticated, no user ID is shown in the header.
When the user is authenticated (user or admin), the header shows a label and the user’s principal (e.g., "User ID: <principal>") on all routes.
The displayed user ID uses the existing principal-formatting helper (short form), and the UI remains responsive (does not break the header layout on mobile or desktop).

file_operations.description: Add a "User ID:" header element that reads the current Internet Identity principal from the existing authentication context (authorization component) after login, formats it with the existing frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal helper, and renders it on all authenticated views. Ensure responsive behavior via layout classes (e.g., min-width handling + truncation) so long principals do not overflow on mobile/desktop, and keep the element hidden when identity is not present. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
